answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the ripple is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest jade a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. So a timber of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1nxrd.
